youtube_title: Why Try When It's This Easy? (Opinion) #Shorts
youtube_description:
An opinion, not a medical claim: science hasn't proven this. But when you can get a dopamine hit alone, instantly and with zero effort, the brain starts preferring the easy route, like junk food over cooking or reels over a book. If it becomes your default stress or boredom escape, the effort real connection needs (talking, confidence, going out) gets skipped. Fix: don't make it your default escape; put that energy into the gym, friends and people. If it feels compulsive, talk to a doctor. No shame in that.
Opinion / habit logic, not medical advice.

Jab dopamine itna easy mile, toh effort kaun kare? 🤔 Opinion hai, science ne prove nahi kiya. Par brain lazy hai — easy reward chunta hai: cooking ki jagah junk food, book ki jagah reels. Default escape ban jaaye toh asli cheez ka effort (baat karna, confidence, bahar nikalna) skip hone lagta hai. Fix: default escape mat banao, energy gym/dosto/logon mein lagao. Compulsive lage toh doctor se baat karo — sharam ki baat nahi.
